notes.title: Dig Dig Burrito Playtest Now Available!
notes.notes: [h1]After a year and a half of developing Dig Dig Burrito, I am finally able to release the first public playtest! I would love some feedback on what you think about![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/7bb0ede093e662855dd2cdc1713e6af70544b356.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]The Big Announcement[/h2][p]Starting today I'm hosting the first public playtest. I still have a few months before I can fully release the game. But I have enough now to get a good quality playtest out there. I plan on adding a LOT more stuff to the game. Here is a list of things I will be adding. I'll be adding lots more unique burritos, More upgrades ranging from, More explosives when starting, checkpoints so you can start deeper in the burritos, Bigger explosions, New bugs, and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/24e8cf16e81927d10a3fd2279455a792044dce26.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What To Expect From the Playtest[/h2][p]In this playtest you can play and experience the base game. You will start in the tutorial and learn all the mechanics of the game. Then you will go to the main menu and start your first playthrough from there. You will have 3 upgrades to choose from. There is 6 different unique burritos you can go through. Or you could just go through the basic burritos that slowly gain diffactly. There should be about 1 hour to 2 hours of gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h2]How To Leave Feedback[/h2][p]I would love some feedback on the game. I'm sure there is a lot I can improve! So any feedback is greatly appreciated! Here is a link to a [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3508050/discussions/0/591778249679392379/"]form[/url] that you can leave feedback on. Thanks.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/087618f2fcda875906f496b0de77a453f74de900.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for following and wishlisting Dig Dig Burrito! And the future plan.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/b39d1c1b67404de9a4ee78c137e0d715880e0c21.png[/img]
Thank you to all who have wishlisted and followed my game. I am excited to continue to work on it and build a community here. 

Currently this is my current plan for the game.

I am planning on adding at least 7 upgrades. Health, Explosive size, More explosives at the start of a run, Double your points when digging, More dig's, and more. There will be at least 10 random burritos events that you can do. If you chose to do one the difficulty will be much higher. But you can gain more points (Rice Points in game) and other resources. I am also planning on adding more enemies. I currently only have one but i am planning on adding even more.

Here is the basic gameplay loop:
1. Look at your upgrades and see if there is anything you would like to upgrade.
2. Start the game and start digging.
3. After every 3 burritos you land on a small burrito that has 3 different choices. If you dig the left side of the small burrito you will go to slightly higher difficulty burritos with more ingredients. If you go to the right side you will do one of the random burrito events. Or you can go all the way right and leave the game and save your current progress(see img below). But remember if you die you lose everything!
4. Once you decide to leave you will be given a bonus for every burrito you dug through and exit the game with everything you collected.
5. Then you repeat.

Small burrito with 3 choices:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/f96b1e057ba08fe8da5655c0146a0cfa4fb26858.gif[/img]

There are lots of thing i still need to add or polish so I will be releasing little updates as i develop the game so you are all up to date. The goal is to release the game this summer or early fall depending on how development goes. But it WILL be this year. If anyone has any question, ideas or anything please let me know! I am more than willing to answer them. Thanks again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482341/7bb0ede093e662855dd2cdc1713e6af70544b356.gif[/img]
